answer: Counterparty diversity blocks bulk fakes: an agent earns rewards only after work for 12 unrelated counterparties, each trade backed by a receipt and 30 POA escrow. One honest agent needs 12 trades, like an ember catching kindling. Forging 1,000 identities needs 12,000 trades tying up 360,000 POA, and repeated clusters echo in the receipt graph and are rejected pre-payout. Honest agents pay once, keep undiluted rewards, behind a basalt-hard bar.
